==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Ahhh, I've been to Teth myself. Pretty planet.|The security guard, to a [[Unidentified Tethan youngling|Tethan Human youngling]] in one adventure path in ''The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure''|<ref name="Tethan" />}}
The security guard appeared in [[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure|''Tethan Battle Adventure'']], a [[2010]] entry in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny]]'' series of choose-your-own-adventure books.<ref name="Tethan" />
